settings.title: Shipping information
settings.content:
Shipping Policy

We offer shipping across India. All orders are processed within 1–2 business days.

Once shipped, delivery usually takes 3–7 business days depending on your location.

We charge a flat shipping fee of ₹69 on cash on delivery and 40% off on prepaid order. Free shipping is available on orders above ₹999.

You will receive a tracking link via email or SMS once your order has been shipped.

In case of failed delivery due to incorrect address or unavailability, re-shipping charges may apply.
